title: Saving a new description changes it at every location
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between two locations: the test location and location B.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test at the test location and at location B under the same part number, with description 1.
  • Use a new description, description 2.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Replace the Description with description 2.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Click Part Library in the left menu.
  6. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  7. Pick location B in the location selector at the top right.
  8. Click Parts in the top bar.
  9. Click Inventory in the left menu.
  10. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed with description 1.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A.

Step 3:

  • Description shows description 2.

Step 4:

  • The window closes and the test location's part A row shows description 2.

Step 5:

  • The Part Library page opens.

Step 6:

  • Part A's one entry shows description 2.

Step 7:

  • The location selector shows location B.

Step 8:

  • The Parts left menu shows Inventory.

Step 9:

  • Location B's Inventory page opens.

Step 10:

  • At location B part A also shows description 2.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S13-R14: “Saving a changed description changes the part's Part Library entry, so every location that stocks the part shows the new description.”
  • Feature Overview, Core functionality: “A part's number and description can be edited from the part dialog. The change is made to the part's own Part Library entry, which every location that stocks the part shares.”
  • Feature Overview, Out of scope: “A description that differs by location. A part has one description, shared by every location that stocks it.”
